definitions.gloss: affected area; diseased part; injured area
definitions.explanation: The specific part of the body that is injured, infected, or afflicted with disease. A medical term commonly used by doctors and in everyday health contexts.

examples.japanese: {患部|かんぶ}を{冷|ひ}やしてください。
{患部|かんぶ}に{薬|くすり}を{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I applied medicine to the affected area.

examples.japanese: {患部|かんぶ}が{腫|は}れて{痛|いた}みがあるので、{早|はや}めに{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: The affected area is swollen and painful, so you should go to the hospital soon.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard medical term used by doctors, pharmacists, and in everyday health conversations. Not to be confused with the homophone {幹部|かんぶ} (executive, leader of an organization).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {患部|かんぶ}を{冷|ひ}やす (to cool the affected area)
- {患部|かんぶ}に{塗|ぬ}る (to apply to the affected area)
- {患部|かんぶ}が{腫|は}れる (the affected area swells)
- {患部|かんぶ}を{保護|ほご}する (to protect the affected area)
